user_story: As a user, I want to mark a task as complete so that I can track my progress.

positive.title: Mark a task as complete when task ID exists and is active
steps: Click on the checkbox to mark the task as complete
positive.expected_result: The task is marked as complete, visually updated in the UI, and the status is saved in the database.

negative.title: Attempt to mark a non-existent task as complete
steps: Navigate to a direct URL or use an API endpoint with an invalid task ID to mark it as complete
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed stating that the task does not exist, and no changes are made to any task.

edge.title: Attempt to mark a task as complete that is already completed
steps: Identify a task that is already marked as complete
Attempt to click on the checkbox again to mark the task as complete
edge.expected_result: The task remains marked as complete without any change or error message, ensuring idempotency of the action.
